title: Buy from a vendor, sell on the AH
summary: The Flips tab finds items vendors sell that go for more on the Auction House, after the cut.

steps.say: The Flips tab needs no crafting: it lists items a vendor sells that go for more on the Auction House.
Each row shows what the vendor charges, what one sells for on the AH after the 5% cut, and the profit per item.
"limited" means the vendor only has a few in stock. The listed count is how many are already on the AH.
Hover a flip to see the item and its prices.

expect.tooltip: Click to print where to buy and how much it makes

steps.say: Click it to print where to buy it and the profit for your quantity.
The details are in chat: which vendor sells it, the AH price and the profit for 10.
